Overview.Name: Darsi Lalitha Sarvani
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1: Option 1: 2 egg omelette + any 1 fruit (apple, banana, orange or papaya)
Option 2: Paneer cubes (80–100 g) + any 1 fruit
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (1 bowl ~150 g) + paneer cubes (60 g)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2–3 eggs) & vegetable curry + curd (small bowl)
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (100 g) & vegetable curry + curd
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & vegetable curry & curd + paneer cubes (60 g)
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg omelette (2 eggs) & vegetable curry + any 1 fruit
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer cubes (80 g) & vegetable curry + any 1 fruit
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & curd (200 g) & cucumber salad + any 1 fruit

Notes_and_Tips: Start meals with eggs or paneer before eating rice to control portions.
Avoid fried and spicy outside food, especially during stress or late nights.
Maintain consistent meal timing despite shift work.
Good sleep is important for thyroid balance and fat loss.
Simple meals will help you stay consistent and reduce cravings.
